extension.name: Test Coverage Drift Control
extension.description: Generate incremental coverage drift reports and planned remediation tasks after implementation
extension.author: Igor Benicio de Mesquita

commands.name: speckit.test-coverage-drift-control.report
commands.description: Generate or incrementally refresh test-coverage-drift-report.md for the active feature

commands.name: speckit.test-coverage-drift-control.remediation-plan
commands.description: Record remediation plans and append Spec Kit coverage remediation tasks from the drift report

hooks.prompt: Run test coverage drift control after implementation?
hooks.description: Generate or incrementally refresh the test coverage drift report for the active feature
